output.reason: The brief convincingly attributes the drop to Corvane rule AUTO-LIB-17. The failures started one minute after the rule went live, they hit every app and OS version, and only password logins are affected. That fits the evidence I've seen. It also gives clear next steps: switch the rule to log-only, verify recovery, and drop the rollback. One caveat is that I can't check the rule and timing data myself.
